views.front: The upholstered stool back now connects to the seat assembly through two narrow rear uprights.
views.rear: The rear view retains the soft back cushion with its lower corners supported above the seat frame.
views.detail: The seat welt now follows the complete cushion edge without the former isolated corner remnants.
views.underside: The original four legs and footrest remain joined to the seat pan and new back supports.
views.clay: The neutral view confirms a connected chair structure and continuous cushion piping.
